title: Nepalese education consultancies protest sweeping new regulations
summary_en: Nepal's education consultancy sector has launched nationwide protests against sweeping new regulations, warning they could force smaller agencies to close and make overseas study less accessible as discussions over proposed amendments get under way.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: Nepalese education consultancies protest sweeping new regulations

title: UK sector sets out wishlist as Andy Burnham takes No. 10
summary_en: UK international education stakeholders have urged the UK's new Prime Minister to maintain the Graduate Route, scrap the controversial levy on private school fees, and strengthen ties with key sending markets.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: UK sector sets out wishlist as Andy Burnham takes No. 10

title: India attracts students from 173 countries as overseas enrolment rises 19%
summary_en: Latest AISHE figures show India enrolled more than 58,000 international students in 2023/24, with Nepal remaining the largest source market and Karnataka emerging as the leading destination state.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: India attracts students from 173 countries as overseas enrolment rises 19%

title: “The tsunami keeps coming”: US leaders react to final D/S rule
summary_en: Following the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) announcing the end of duration of status, leaders share their take on the Trump administration’s “arbitrary intrusion” into higher education.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: “The tsunami keeps coming”: US leaders react to final D/S rule

title: Canada fraud case exposes “acute” sector integrity issues
summary_en: Two people have been charged for an immigration scheme in Canada defrauding international students of CAD$126,000 – as the case raises longstanding concerns about unethical recruitment practices.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: Canada fraud case exposes “acute” sector integrity issues

title: Fulbright lives to see another day as elimination amendment defeated
summary_en: US lawmakers have voted down a proposal to scrap the Fulbright program, with stakeholders hailing strong bipartisan backing for international exchange.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: Fulbright lives to see another day as elimination amendment defeated
